subject: Anthropology
title: Cosmology and Worldview
description: A fast breakdown of Cosmology and Worldview for builders.

hook.text: The Navajo walk in beauty between four sacred mountains. Their landscape is their cosmology made physical.

buildup.text: Cosmology is a society's model of the universe — its structure, origins, and the place of humans within it.

discovery.text: Cosmologies shape daily life: when to plant, how to heal, where to bury the dead, and which direction to pray.

twist.text: Western cosmology separates nature and culture. Many Indigenous cosmologies see no such divide — all is interconnected.

climax.text: Cosmology isn't abstract philosophy. It's the invisible map that guides every action and decision in a culture.

punchline.text: How you see the universe shapes how you live in it.

quiz.question: What is cosmology in anthropology?
options: A society's model of the universe and humanity's place in it

details.summary: Cosmology is a culture's understanding of the universe's structure, origin, and operating principles. Worldview encompasses the broader framework through which a people interpret all experience. Together they form the deep assumptions that shape how cultures see reality.
details.whyItMatters: Cosmology and worldview are the invisible frameworks beneath all cultural behavior. Understanding them explains why people in different cultures can look at the same events and interpret them in fundamentally different ways.
takeaways: Cosmology explains a culture's model of the universe's structure
Worldview is the broader framework for interpreting all experience
These deep assumptions shape how cultures perceive reality itself

faq.question: How does cosmology differ from worldview?
faq.answer: Cosmology is specifically about the structure and nature of the universe — how many realms exist, what forces govern them. Worldview is broader, encompassing assumptions about human nature, morality, time, and the meaning of life. Cosmology is part of worldview.

faq.question: Can people hold multiple worldviews simultaneously?
faq.answer: Yes. Many people navigate between scientific and religious worldviews depending on context. A doctor may use biomedical cosmology at work and participate in spiritual healing at home. Worldview pluralism is common in globalized societies.
